project_name: Eurogulf Mobility Group (EGMG) Website Redesign - Phase 1
design_philosophy: Light-First Premium Corporate Mobility - Fusion of Swiss Precision & UAE Luxury

theme_setting.rationale: Brand guidelines dictate a clean, high-clarity light background (#EEEDE7 / #FAFAFA / #FFFFFF) with stark black typography (#000000) and vibrant brand orange (#EE5A01) focal points.

brand_identity.secondary_slogan: Strength moves us. We move you.
brand_identity.voice_and_tone: Authoritative, Innovative, Trustworthy, Dynamic, Empowering, Approachable

contrast_compliance.orange_on_white_text: Use Orange (#EE5A01) for text sizes 18px+ bold or as background container fills with White (#FFFFFF) text. For small text on white, use Black (#000000) or Charcoal (#121212) with Orange icons or left accent bars.

orange_label_chip.description: Rounded orange background block behind overline section labels as shown in Brand Guidelines p.42
orange_label_chip.class_name: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#EE5A01] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest

numbered_step_card.description: Numbered 'Steps 01-04' process strip with square orange number chips
numbered_step_card.number_chip: w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-[#EE5A01] text-white font-montserrat font-black text-lg flex items-center justify-center shadow-md
numbered_step_card.card: bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-black/5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

orange_accent_line.description: Diagonal or solid orange underline accent under main section titles
orange_accent_line.class_name: w-16 h-1 bg-[#EE5A01] rounded-full mt-3 mb-6

isometric_cube_icon.description: EGMG isometric cube motif used in card badges, section dividers, and quote cards

rtl_mirror_guidelines.layout_rule: Apply dir='rtl' on <html> tag when language is AR. Flip grid orders, flex directions, chevron icons, and navigation alignment automatically.

data_testid_rules.convention: kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-about', data-testid='quote-cta-button', data-testid='brand-card-europcar', data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Montserrat is loaded for all headings and Roboto for body copy.
Remove any dark/light theme switcher toggle from the UI.
Maintain high contrast light surfaces (#FAFAFA, #EEEDE7, #FFFFFF) with stark black titles (#000000) and vibrant orange focal points (#EE5A01).
Use the signature orange label chip and 4-step numbered card components across key pages.
Ensure all 7 brand tiles and navigation links map accurately in desktop mega menus and mobile accordions.
Implement mobile sticky action bar (Call / WhatsApp / Quote) for viewports < 768px.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
